structure: Part 7, COVERAGE.md. Read in full: COVERAGE.md (201 lines), plus README.md, e2e/support/fixtures.js and e2e/support/evidence.js for context. COVERAGE.md has an intro (prototype pulled from main on 7 October 2026, 103 tests all passing, the route table generated from the trace and evidence indexes, 'Visited by' counting redirect hops), then four sections. Routes: a generated table between routes:start and routes:end of 65 GET routes under /design-release-2.1 (not 67 as the partition expected), each with the view it renders (DR2.1 override, shared root view, or redirect), how many tests visit it with one example test name, and the evidence states captured; claimed one route per claim (p7-001 to p7-065), with the example test names that state a behaviour claimed separately (p7-176 to p7-208). DR2.1 override views: 36 rows, one per file in app/views/design-release-2.1/, with the routes that render each and whether it is visited; all are visited except permanent-address, which is unreachable; claimed p7-066 to p7-101. Not reached, and why: 5 items (permanent-address override, the virus-check JSON endpoint, the address-book usage page, dashboard pagination and filter results, POST /intro/sign-in), split into p7-109 to p7-118. Behaviour worth knowing: 15 numbered items, each split into one claim per fact (p7-119 to p7-175); the two facts in item 6 that COVERAGE.md marks observed in exploration but not asserted are inferred. README and the support plumbing add how traces record every main-frame request including redirect hops, and that each evidence state is owned by the first test to reach it (p7-205, p7-206); the README's arrival-date window is cited alongside item 11 (p7-161).
